method: Literature survey of connectome-constrained neural-dynamics models known to the authors as of the check date. This is an honest-inventory artifact, not an automated proof of firstness; audit O7 requires a timestamped re-check the week before any upload.

prior_art_inventory.relation: DIRECT PRIOR ART. A trained recurrent model of neural dynamics constrained by the same male CNS connectome class. FlyGPT is conditioned on the same prior work's published conventions (20 ms dt, ~100 ms tau_v) and diverges in architecture and objective, documented in sim_v1.yaml's backend audit.
distinguishing_features_of_this_work: autoregressive transformer over hybrid event+type token streams trained on a corpus-scale simulated event set, rather than a recurrent rate model
connectome-masked attention using the CSR graph as a structural prior
sex-conditioned vocabulary + alignment (male MaleCNS vs female BANC)
reproducible event-list corpus with sharded provenance and pilot-gate health checks
behavior/song decoding and control-graph ablation battery

prior_art_inventory.work: Lappalainen et al. 2024 (NeuroMechFly / kinematics) and related embodied fly models
prior_art_inventory.relation: Different problem class (biomechanical/kinematic, not synapse-resolution dynamics)

prior_art_inventory.work: Generic connectome-based inference / fly connectomics releases (FlyWire, hemibrain, MANC, MaleCNS, BANC)
prior_art_inventory.relation: Data releases and analyses, not trained generative dynamics models

C20.claim: first trained generative model of a complete, synapse-resolution animal connectome's dynamics
C20.reason: flybrain is a trained model of the same connectome's dynamics; the defensible refinement is 'first autoregressive transformer trained generatively over tokenized event streams of the complete connectome' - narrower and perishable; kept UNSUPPORTED until formal recheck

C21.claim: first neural dynamics model conditioned on biological sex at the level of a complete CNS wiring diagram
C21.reason: sex-conditioned multi-graph training is not known to exist in the surveyed prior art, but the claim is perishable and must be re-checked before release

required_before_release: Timestamped literature re-check (audit O7) within 7 days of any public upload; 'to our knowledge' + date qualifiers are mandatory on both claims.
